rule: Each box has one oval and one square. In figures 1, 2, 4 and 5 the oval sits clearly higher than the square (oval in the top part, square in the bottom part). In figure 3 the oval is level with the square at the bottom, so it breaks the rule. Another rule (oval and square in opposite left/right halves) would make 4 the odd one, so this is ambiguous.
options_check: 1: oval top-left, square bottom-right, oval above square, fits. 2: same as 1, fits. 3: oval bottom-left, level with square, breaks the rule. 4: oval top-right, square directly below, oval above square, fits this rule (but both are on the right half, which would break the alternative rule). 5: oval top-right, square bottom-left, oval above square, fits.
redraw_diffs: Redraw is roughly right in layout but not exact. Redraw puts ovals touching the left wall in figs 1-3 and the square in fig 5 touching the left wall and bottom, and the fig 4 square touching the bottom edge. In the original nothing touches the walls (small gaps everywhere), and fig 3 oval is slightly lower/larger relative gap. Fig 5 square in original sits a bit above the bottom with a gap. These touching differences could matter if the intended rule is about touching, but none of the original shows touching.
